events.title: Demo Hotfix: Story Clarity & Visual Improvements
events.summary: We've updated the demo based on your feedback:Fixed instances where dialogue used the default protagonist name instead of your chosen name.Clarified where off-screen voices come from, including inside and outside dreams.Improved localization and refreshed several character illustrations.Added a spoiler-safe ending recap with direct access to the Journal.Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback!
